text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have fun! Let's liven things up, 
okay? 
—Cheers! Though it's just hot water."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Cheers! 
The aesthetician did say... no juice, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Drink only hot water after 10 PM... was 
it? 
Is beauty really that paramount to 
Ramonu-senpai?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I honestly couldn't see any training 
value in beauty care. 
However, given the sheer gap in our 
abilities... there must be something..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Wah?! Heart-san?! 
What was that for all of a sudden~?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, didn't I say? It's a party! 
Which naturally means—take another one!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Pffft—!! Why you~~! 
If that's how you want to play, I'm 
dual-wielding!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Eek! Craft-san, you're hitting 
bystanders...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—Fufu, Messiah-san, in that case, 
let us form an alliance!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... fufu, that got surprisingly 
intense, didn't it? 
Haah... so warm..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—The wrinkle between your brows is gone. 
No gloomy faces allowed. Let's keep things 
positive, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... fufu, thank you. Thanks to that, 
I feel like I've loosened up a bit. Let's 
look forward—oh, I know!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we try solving it like a 
riddle? The meaning behind Ramonu-san's 
words. 
She said quite a few enigmatic things, 
didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... The one that caught my 
attention was 'Mon Amour.' 
She also mentioned something about a 
beloved one, but it was rather 
mysterious."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. And we also talked about dreams 
sworn at ceremonies, right? Back then, she 
told me my dream was 
'noble.' That's been bothering me a little 
too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"'Noble,' huh... sounds sarcastic to me. 
It's hard to imagine that was actually a 
compliment..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Though from my perspective, the 'love' 
and 'romance' Ramonu-san talks about 
feels like a much more... 
higher-dimensional concept."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Romance, huh~...! Ah, that reminds me! A 
friend of mine 
finally had a LANE call with her crush!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"She was so nervous she couldn't remember 
a single thing she said~! 
I wonder if Ramonu-san has feelings like 
that too?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... Ah, but according to my 
classmate, the popular romance drama this 
season 
is all about 'healing-type partners.' 
...Could love also be healing?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... I watch romance plays quite often, 
but 
there are plenty of scenes where they're 
just so happy they want to dance!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"But love and romance aren't always so 
bright and cheerful, are they? 
Sometimes you'd do anything just to 
possess the other person's heart."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the methods are forceful and 
ruthless... displaying terrifying 
obsession...! 
............Not talking about me, by the 
way. That's from a shark movie."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"T-There are scary stories like that...?!  
And here I thought shark movies were just 
panic thrillers...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Does it really have to be through racing? 
—Truly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Brrrrring!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, so after that, we ended up...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—Falling asleep, didn't we? 
Good morning, Heart-san."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Good morning. ...Without reaching an 
answer, no less. 
—However, our time is limited!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"We might not understand Ramonu-san's true 
intentions yet, but as we copy her 
actions, 
we might stumble upon a clue."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Either way, let's keep up with her for 
now! 
—Craft, it's morning! Messiah, wake up 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This time it's a hot spring early in the 
morning...? 
Why—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Over here."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"............... 
—Hey, is this body maintenance too... I 
wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I'm certain it's good for 
health, but..."

text_block_list.name: Footbath Attendant
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the primary benefit of this footbath 
is skin beautification. 
It stimulates blood flow and is expected 
to activate skin cell metabolism."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. This is a device to improve blood 
circulation, right? 
Could it be that by improving whole-body 
circulation, it also has an effect on the 
legs...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Do you have leg blood vessels on your 
face?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...No. My apologies."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So it really only works on the face?! 
What does that even mean... Does she... 
run with her face...?!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san, calm down! 
Even Ramonu-san wouldn't run with her 
face... probably! I think!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Phew. ...Fufu, splendid. Perfectly 
beautiful—indeed. 
Now then, barbells next."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"?! Barbells on top of that...?! 
She's a monster...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Good work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for having us these past two 
days.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...The only thing I gained from this is 
the sheer fact that Ramonu-san's 
experience and training are simply on an 
overwhelming level.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Other than that, nothing... I couldn't 
understand her true motives, nor do I feel 
any closer to her. ...Even though this was 
such a precious opportunity.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
............ 
...Fine. Do as you please with the rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu plans to continue her 
intensive training at the main estate next 
weekend as well. 
If any of you wish to attend, you are more 
than welcome to join.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure...?  
............

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: What should we do about next week...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If there's even the slightest bit to 
learn, I believe we should hold on tight 
and attend. 
However... I'm not sure if Ramonu-senpai 
truly welcomes our presence...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ......I wonder.
